title: Repository Brain tooling and safe adoption

authorization.reference: User in this chat, 2026-10-01: ok proceed and implement it, following the proposed file-backed Brain design.

excludedActions: Automatic check execution or agent dispatch
External systems, credentials, deployment or global configuration
Replacing legacy platform evidence or claiming new platform acceptance

criteria.description: Usable validate, context, record and checkpoint commands with explicit root and actionable errors.
criteria.evidenceScope: Actual isolated CLI and core integration tests.

criteria.description: Immutable task/contract/candidate-bound records and copied evidence with integrity validation.
criteria.evidenceScope: Local file-backed records; attributed reports do not authenticate execution or approval.

criteria.description: Exclusive participating-writer lock, stale revision rejection, immutable event before pointer and repairable generated view.
criteria.evidenceScope: Cooperating local CLI writers; no hostile-filesystem or power-loss guarantee.

criteria.description: Acceptance requires qualifying current-candidate evidence and required attributed independent review.
criteria.evidenceScope: Record consistency; unknown, blocked, stale or failed required evidence does not pass.

criteria.description: Preserve legacy records and platform task mapping; generated current view clearly separates imported platform and maintenance work.
criteria.evidenceScope: Actual project validation and read-only context after adoption; no fresh platform qualification.

criteria.description: Build first, execute focused checks and npm test, and record every blocked, skipped or unrelated failing suite gate separately.
criteria.evidenceScope: Fresh command logs and counts. Existing platform/native/provider exclusions do not become new tooling pass claims.
